card.name: Closing quote after a sentence ends
card.fires_on: Closing quotation marks (often with a period before them) at the end of a quoted passage in web prose, just before the text moves on to something else.

modes.label: Period plus closing quote
modes.description: A sentence-ending period fused with a closing curly quote that ends a quoted passage.
modes.example: help them run Historypin workshops with their children, parents and grandparents<<.”>>

modes.label: Bare closing quote
modes.description: A closing quote mark alone, after a quoted statement or a link.
modes.example: for longer could save more lives with minimal additional side effects<<” >>While the changes are only a few percent
